_about: Main settings for Goalscraper (data from OpenFootAPI's free plan). The model's learned adjustments live in data/model_state.json, not here.

sections._about: Each section's 1-100 scale is set by the chance of the pick going wrong: 'fail_at_100' scores 100, 'fail_at_50' scores 50 (the pass mark). Easy Goals goes wrong on a 0-0; Misses if the team wins; Ballon d'Or if the team doesn't win; Raining Goals if either team fails to score.

starting_values._about: Where the model starts. The daily self-adjustment moves these within limits; see the Coverage tab.

requests._about: OpenFootAPI free plan: 5,000 requests a month. A normal day uses about 10-20; the first run uses more to collect the season so far.
